comment: The kit's own jellyfin-web DOM anchors, in the shape of a plugin's Web/anchors.json. Kit.props embeds this file as Kit.anchors.json. The kit's code finds them through KIT_ANCHORS in kit.js (tests/health.test.mjs keeps both equal); this list is what the kit's health checks report (kit.health.expect) and what the server accepts in ClientHealth reports, next to the plugin's own anchors, and what scripts/Test-WebAnchors.ps1 looks for in the installed jellyfin-web bundle. Names start with 'kit.'.

anchors.name: kit.f1Host
anchors.note: FallbackRoute's page, shown for routes jellyfin-web doesn't know: the fallback host of every user page. React component in main.jellyfin.bundle.js. Missing: pages on their fallback routes can't show.

anchors.name: kit.pluginPagesHost
anchors.note: The view Plugin Pages hosts its pages in (#/userpluginsettings.html). Missing: pages use their fallback routes.

anchors.name: kit.drawer
anchors.note: The legacy drawer's scroll container, parent of the "Library tools" section. Absent in the experimental layout. Missing: no nav links; the routes still work.

anchors.name: kit.userMenu
anchors.note: The drawer's "User" section, present only while signed in; "Library tools" goes right before it. Missing: no nav links.

anchors.name: kit.nativeDialog
anchors.note: jellyfin-web's own dialogs and action sheets (dialogHelper's container); while one is open the kit's shortcuts stay quiet. A presence probe, never health-checked: its absence means no native dialog is open.

anchors.name: kit.actionSheet
anchors.note: An action sheet (the item menu, the bulk menu), a new one per menu in a .dialogContainer appended to <body>. Lazy chunk 62882.*.chunk.js. Missing (a recorded menu trigger that no sheet followed within 8 s): no kit.actionSheet entries.

anchors.name: kit.actionSheetRows
anchors.note: A sheet's rows, each with its command in data-id; the item menu is told apart by its admin-only commands and the bulk menu by selectall. Missing (a sheet opened from a recorded trigger without them): no kit.actionSheet entries.

anchors.name: kit.itemMenuButton
anchors.note: A card's or a list row's "⋮" button, inside the item's [data-id] element. A presence probe for Test-WebAnchors.ps1, never health-checked: not every view has cards.

anchors.name: kit.detailsMoreButton
anchors.note: A details page's "More" button, which opens the item menu. A presence probe, never health-checked.

anchors.name: kit.detailsVersion
anchors.note: A details page's version picker; its value is the chosen version's item id, the item its menu is for. A presence probe, never health-checked: hidden or absent for a single version, when the hash id is the item.

anchors.name: kit.selectionMenuButton
anchors.note: The selection bar's "⋮" button, which opens the bulk menu. A presence probe, never health-checked: there only in selection mode.

anchors.name: kit.selectionCheckbox
anchors.note: A card's checkbox in selection mode; the checked ones' cards are the bulk menu's items. A presence probe, never health-checked.

anchors.name: kit.selectionClose
anchors.note: The selection bar's close button; ctx.exitSelection() clicks it. A presence probe, never health-checked.
